name: Hero Banner
description: Adds a rotating hero banner of the latest additions per library to the home screen.
overview: Adds a rotating hero banner of the latest additions per library to the home screen.

versions.changelog: Refresh the banner visually - artwork now cross-fades with a slow push-in, the library name sits in a badge, a year/rating/runtime/genre line appears under the title, the buttons carry icons, and the slide indicators fill up over the rotation interval. Adds narrow-screen and reduced-motion handling.

Fix the settings page never loading its script (fields were empty and Save did nothing), keep the banner on the Home tab instead of leaking onto Favorites, bring the banner back after navigating away and home again, stop the rotation timer from being reset by unrelated DOM changes, hide the banner when no library matches the filters, and require a signed-in user for the settings endpoint.
Guard the settings page and banner UI against missing dashboard APIs and empty slide state so configuration changes and home-page refreshes do not crash the page.
